trace.finding: getDataTable/logbugly receive logical code identities only. Current event wrappers do not wrap either helper or lookupDataTable. Future tracing changes require re-audit; preserve the public lookup function object/source metadata.

measuredEvidence.finding: Measured CPU evidence prioritizes Unit.update/addBuff/constructors/copy and property access. No lookup value-cache implementation or speedup is justified by this assessment.

cases.name: zero_arguments_do_not_read_loader
cases.obligation: Return null before any source loader lookup or callback for zero arguments. Native admission itself must remain getter-free.

cases.name: false_keys_skip_but_negative_zero_indexes
cases.obligation: Path keys use s || s===0: false, empty string, null, undefined and NaN skip; both signed zeros index property 0.

cases.name: falsy_field_returns_current_row
cases.obligation: The second argument uses truthiness, not property-key existence. A false field selects the current row object.

cases.name: returned_row_alias_is_canonical
cases.obligation: Raw performance-mode table rows escape and are mutable. Do not share a cloned result or treat prior guarded coverage as a general immutability proof.

cases.name: raw_leaf_changes_after_cold_lookup
cases.obligation: Value memoization is invalid even if root-set identity and function identity stay unchanged. A slot-plan cache must load current values on every hit.

cases.name: raw_child_replacement_under_same_lease
cases.obligation: A retained root-set does not prevent replacement of descendants. Resolve nodes from fresh canonical root slots, not stored raw VM pointers.

cases.name: signed_zero_leaf_change
cases.obligation: Numeric cache validation needs raw bits; === merges signed zeros, and Object.is alone merges distinct NaN payloads. Current slot reads avoid stale numeric snapshots.

cases.name: own_getter_added_after_cold_lookup
cases.obligation: Shape/descriptor changes must reject before source effects. Descriptor preflight must first reject Proxy/exotic objects without invoking their traps.

cases.name: inherited_path_getter_is_observable
cases.obligation: Only own data paths can be admitted. An inherited getter may run callbacks, mutate future keys or throw.

cases.name: falsy_intermediate_still_reads_wx
cases.obligation: return void window.wx always returns undefined but must execute the wx read and any getter. Do not cache misses or early-falsy paths.

cases.name: push_override_is_observable
cases.obligation: The otherwise unused n.push is observable. Guard the actual inherited push data function and fresh-array prototype chain before eliding it.

cases.name: native_push_still_runs_inherited_index_setter
cases.obligation: Original native push is insufficient: Set-style append can invoke inherited indexed setters. Reject digit-leading own keys on Array/Object prototypes and changed chains.

cases.name: object_prototype_index_setter
cases.obligation: The indexed append guard must cover Object.prototype as well as Array.prototype.

cases.name: push_precedes_key_coercion
cases.obligation: Reject coercing keys before any effect; original fallback must retain push-before-ToPropertyKey ordering.

cases.name: unchanged_loader_identity_is_not_purity
cases.obligation: The emitted loader dynamically reads Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call. Guard the entire property/call chain, not just ed.getDataTable identity.

cases.name: loader_can_change_push_before_loop
cases.obligation: An entry-time push guard is insufficient if any admitted loader/path operation can run user code before later pushes. Prove the complete admitted path callback-free.

cases.name: getter_exception_identity_escapes
cases.obligation: The try/catch covers only getDataTable; path/field errors propagate by identity. Never replay the source after partial effects.

cases.name: loader_error_logs_all_arguments_then_null
events: getDataTableCatchError: Param0: Test Param1: n Param2: row
cases.obligation: Loader exceptions run ordered argument-string coercions and logbugly; its return value is discarded. Unsupported admission must fall back before calling the loader.

conclusion: Do not implement generic value memoization. Worker root retention proves lifetime, not immutability of raw performance-mode rows. Every workload still needs its guarded fidelity gate.

A possible native slot-plan cache stores keys/SymbolIDs/slot offsets, guards current classes and own data descriptors, and loads current nodes/values through GC-aware canonical roots every time. It must not retain unrooted VM pointers or obsolete descendant aliases.

Native class-cache rooting remains an implementation blocker: any stored HiddenClass reference must use supported traced/weak runtime cache storage; stable class pointers cannot be assumed across moving GC.
Proxy/exotic detection and every admission check must be getter-free and precede source effects. Unsupported inputs execute the original once; no fallback after partial calls.
Immutable qualification Proxies require separate source-bound handler/counter/lazy-proxy proofs. No proxy-counter synthesis is implemented or approved here.

Skip unused path arrays or loader calls only after proving all relevant dynamic intrinsic/prototype chains and admitted own-data operations callback-free. Keep original warnings/errors/coercions/order and function metadata.
scope: 18 directed source executions establish concrete obligations and counterexamples, not a native optimization, complete guard proof, broad battle qualification, or performance result.
